description: Cloud-based email delivery and marketing platform for sending transactional and marketing emails at scale via APIs and SMTP.
auth_notes: API keys passed via Bearer token in the Authorization header or via HTTP Basic authentication (username 'apikey', password is the API key).
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free tier account self-serve and generate API keys directly from the console settings.
api_notes: Comprehensive v3 REST API covering mail sending, dynamic templates, contacts management, marketing campaigns, stats, and webhooks.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by SendGrid/Twilio; community servers may exist.
rationale: SendGrid provides a fully documented public v3 REST API with self-serve free account tier creation and standard API key authentication.

evidence.note: Documents API key usage via Bearer token and Basic auth.
Explains how to create and manage API keys via the SendGrid UI.
Details the SendGrid v3 Web API REST interface.
